cases.prompt: Our workflow runs mvn package, builds the image, and deploys. Review it: unit tests and Testcontainers tests are both in the package step.
expectations: Explains that mvn package does not run the failsafe integration-test goal so the split does not exist yet
Proposes separate verify, verify-integration, build, scan, sign, publish, and deploy stages with a gate at each
Requires the fast unit stage to reject a broken commit before any container is started
Keeps build once and promote the same digest so the tested artifact is the shipped artifact

cases.prompt: Our GitHub Actions cache for ~/.m2/repository is keyed on the branch name, so we keep getting dependency resolution failures after a pom change.
expectations: Rejects a branch-only key because it restores a stale repository and pairs it with new pom.xml
Requires the key to include hashFiles of every pom.xml so any dependency change invalidates it
Adds restore-keys with a prefix for a warm start that re-downloads only what is missing
Requires the committed Maven wrapper and the batch non-interactive flags, and forbids caching target

cases.prompt: We pass the database password to the Docker build as --build-arg DB_PASSWORD so the app can read it. How do we fix it?
expectations: States that build args and Dockerfile ARG values are recorded in image history and are not secret
Moves application secrets to runtime injection with a NotBlank configuration property that fails at startup
Uses GitHub OIDC for registry and cluster access instead of long-lived cloud keys
Requires rotating the credential that already reached a build layer

cases.prompt: We want to rename the column orders.customer_id to customer_ref in this release. How do we sequence it?
expectations: Rejects a rename in the same release that stops using the old column because rollback would then be impossible
Applies expand-and-contract across three releases with the new column added first and dropped last
Requires migrations to run as an explicit pipeline or Kubernetes Job step that completes before the new version receives traffic
Forbids every replica running migrations at startup during a rolling deploy

cases.prompt: Our deploy job runs helm upgrade --wait and returns. Can we call that a successful deploy?
expectations: Rejects a successful command as proof of a successful deploy
Requires a smoke test of a real write and read path plus a revision check against the info endpoint
Requires a health gate that compares error ratio and p95 latency against the previous revision after a burn-in window
Warns that a passing health check with maxUnavailable zero still needs a readiness threshold below one and a minReadySeconds period

cases.prompt: The deploy dropped a column. We need to roll back to last week's build but the old code selects that column.
expectations: States rollback is impossible and that forward-fix is the only remaining path
Requires the irreversible-release rule that a forward-fix plan exists before any one-way step runs
Reorders the release so the destructive step is last and the previous version stays runnable until the burn-in window closes
Defines retention so the previous digest remains reachable for the error-budget window, not just the deploy
